verdict.rationale: cubic has no documented sandbox or test environment. The closest evidence is auto-approval's shadow mode, which shows which PRs cubic would approve before you switch to live mode. The local `cubic review` CLI also lets you try reviews on uncommitted changes before anything reaches a PR. Both are dry-run safety modes rather than an isolated sandbox with non-production data. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test workspace, isolation of test data from production repos and data, and any hands-on corroboration.
